title: Pre-rendered 3D look
description: Sprites rendered from 3D models with one consistent camera and lighting, then used as 2D images.

art_style.outline_policy: Optional thin outline pass applied the same way to every asset.
art_style.shading_policy: One light direction and one shading model used across the whole game.
art_style.texture_policy: Material detail at one consistent texel size.

native_size_guidance: Draw at about twice the final display size and reduce once with a smooth filter; keep every asset in a set at the same scale.
avoid: Do not change the camera angle between assets.
Do not change the light direction between assets.
